title: OTHRYS OS unified current-work identity
goal: Make the main Mission card, Work inspector and status badge identify the same current Work mission, and remove duplicate Progress chrome.
laws: Visible current-work identity comes from workState when present.
Closed historical activeMission state must not override a newer open Work mission.
The inspector status label must reflect actual Work status.
No mission transition, model, Trust Canal or execution semantics change.
No new write API is added.
Existing Refine authority boundary remains unchanged.
